title: Khovanov homology: pro-tangles, derived colimits and spectral sequences
summary: This paper introduces \emph{pro-tangles}, a natural generalization of classical tangles, which are functors from the Boolean cube to Bar-Natan's cobordism category. By employing the simplicial Yoneda embedding, we construct the Khovanov simplicial presheaf of a pro-tangle as the total homotopy cofiber over the punctured Boolean cube, and prove that this simplicial presheaf is representable, with representing object the classical Khovanov simplicial object.
